Class ModelUpdateLesson

java.lang.Object
guiUpdateLesson.ModelUpdateLesson
public class ModelUpdateLesson extends Object

Title: ModelUpdateLesson Class.

Description: The Update Lesson Model. This class retrieves contributor-owned lessons and their Experiences and persists permitted updates outside of the JavaFX View and Controller.

Version:
1.0 2026-10-23 Initial version after MVC refactoring
Author:
Venus Ho, Alexander Murray, Alan Shimp, Caleb Beaven, Krithik Duraisamy
